item.title: Corrected: GPT-6 Cyber: strong exploit capabilities, 81 high-severity Firefox flaws reported (EV-0302)
item.description: Supplemented with OpenAI's announcement of GPT-6 Cyber and Mozilla's security advisory for Firefox 159 of 27 October 2026: according to OpenAI, the model produced evidence for 81 novel Firefox vulnerabilities rated high severity by Mozilla during a vulnerability research campaign; Mozilla credits OpenAI as reporter of several of these flaws. Because the findings now concern real, shipped software, the setting was changed from "controlled experiment" to "real-world effect".
